BSC37-006.name: ［Witch Quartet Noir］Flamme Sandria
BSC37-006.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
For each "Witch Quartet"-named Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If your Field has six or more [Song] Magic cards, during the next opposing Refresh Step, the opponent can't return any cores, except [Soul Core], from their Trash to the Reserve. This effect can only be used once per game.
